implementation_revision_binding.required_consistency: Resolved commit must equal the exact delivery SHA supplied in the final handoff and future Primary grant implementation_sha. No floating HEAD or descendant is authorized.
implementation_revision_binding.literal_self_SHA_excluded: A tracked file cannot embed its own containing Git SHA. Supply it after commit in the final handoff; no circular metadata-only commits.

inputs_only: original gain indices and exact timestamps
original packet expiry and recorded authority interval
algorithm: Validate a single contiguous original gain-grid population of N<=80 complete 10ms factors. Empty populations remain empty.
For L in [1,5,10,20,40] in this fixed order, skip L>N; otherwise propose [a,a+L) for a in [0,(N-L)//2,N-L], in that fixed early/middle/final order.
Deduplicate by first occurrence; do not sort by result or replace missing lengths with clipped windows.
Use exact timestamps of selected original endpoints. Candidate identity is retained; the same fixed sampling rule applies to all twelve candidates.

For each normalization and selected interval, scan every factor/prefix chronologically with LEFT multiplication. Retain only its endpoint and actual maximum prefix norm/time, including identity prefix 0.
Count deliberately omitted nonempty intervals as N*(N+1)//2-selected_count, separately from missing/censored SELECTED endpoints.
authority: DESIGN_CONDITIONAL is the original untrimmed nominal design suffix through original validity; never ongoing physical authority.
OBSERVED_AUTHORITY contains only complete original 10ms factors after anchor and inside original recorded authority/expiry.
Unsupported leading/trailing off-grid pieces are omitted as unsupported duration; do not approximate them with a 10ms map.
Missing authority/pending evidence does not substitute the design population; an empty observed population emits unavailable status and has zero selected intervals.

normalization_populations.definition: Unchanged accepted Dx similarity; full [.5,.5,1,.1,.75,.1], lateral [.1,.1,.5,1], speed [.5].
Dx=I for dimensional Phi norm; explicitly dependent on physical unit choices.
Multiply only e_y scale (full/lateral) or vx scale (speed) by 0.1; all other accepted scales unchanged.
Multiply the same predeclared coordinate scale by 10; no gain/weight/dynamics change.

sensitivity_rationale: e_y exposes the lateral/corridor perturbation coordinate in coupled and projected lateral products; scalar speed has only vx. Coordinate choice is fixed before any result. Other full/lateral coordinate sensitivities are omitted; full controllability normalization studies are unchanged.

worst_case_product_accounting.derivation: 80 + 3*(1+5+10+20+40) = 308. Each full/short window scans its own prefixes; four bounded passes, no all-starts/all-ends loop.

record_bound_notes: Per map at most eight linearizations, four FD comparisons and three linear-system records; this intentionally overbounds physical maps.
Original gain slots <=960 before dedup. At most 3*960 support closed loops plus 144 delayed selected-point closed loops.
Event reserve includes 432 Schur crosschecks, 24 model differences, 72 panel declarations, 144 map failures, 12 candidate failures, 24 candidate begin/end and five stage/coverage events.

Global stop reduces data coverage; partial/missing observations remain records, not favorable retries. Unknown programming defects propagate; traceback/log bytes are governed by the shared output watcher, not this scientific-record count.
3001 monitor rows is a planning bound from <=300s at 0.1s sampling, not proof of a certified OS scheduling bound.

structural_work_estimates.product_time_complexity: O(C*S*P*Q*(N+3*sum(available L))*[n^3 for multiplication + n^3-order norm work]); fixed C<=12,S=3,P=2,Q=4,N<=80. Non-product derivative/domain/PBH/Riccati work is unchanged and may dominate.
structural_work_estimates.payload_formula: 80*6*6*8 bytes, excluding ndarray/Python metadata and archived source arrays.
structural_work_estimates.candidate_numeric_product_buffers_estima: O(80*(6^2+4^2+1)*8) per design/observed copy plus gain buffers and one current Phi; <0.25 MiB of float64 product/gain matrices per candidate as a coarse structural estimate. This excludes source-adapter, pytest, imports, qualification, JSON and Python object memory.
structural_work_estimates.retained_panel_metadata: <=16 intervals per subsystem/population; no 3240-interval materialization and no list of every prefix matrix. Completed keys/coverage still grow with <=4608 selected endpoint records.
structural_work_estimates.output_estimate: Every scientific row repeats the fixed source-binding header. Product rows add <=80 source IDs/gain indices and <=6x6 endpoint matrices. O(4608*(binding header bytes + product payload)) plus <=8196 other worker rows, <=3001 monitor rows and all test/log/temp artifacts. A conservative 100 KiB average-row planning envelope alone is about 1.51 GiB for 15807 rows, exceeding the 1 GiB reservation; this is an uncertainty envelope, not a measured size or a guarantee that the run will fit.
structural_work_estimates.resource_feasibility: NOT ESTABLISHED STATICALLY. Do not raise caps or transfer CT1N/CT1R allocations; future censoring/incomplete coverage may be necessary.

omissions_and_interpretation.not_evaluated: All other arbitrary-start/arbitrary-end contiguous windows; most interior amplification opportunities; nonselected full/lateral coordinate perturbations.
omissions_and_interpretation.prefix_scope: The full interval scans all prefixes anchored at its first available original factor. A late-starting omitted interval can have a larger amplification; full-prefix maximum is not maximum over all possible starts.
omissions_and_interpretation.failure_counting: Missing selected endpoints and deliberately omitted exhaustive windows have separate fields/events. An unknown population length is null/coverage_unknown, never falsely zero.
